newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care files shelf for $250 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care files shelf for $250 mln in debt.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in debt securities.

The Gaithersburg, Md., company said net proceeds will be used for general corporage purposes, which may include capital expenditures, possible acquitisions, repurchase of the company's stock and payment of other debt.
Manor Care and other subsidiaries have been engaged since October 1968 in the business of developing, owing and managing nursing centers that provide skilled nursing and convalescent care.
